newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mostly steady on Wednesday as some dealers said the focus was on nearby demand for mids.

Markets were very quiet. There was no forward contracting, a Carolinas dealer said, noting that feed mills were not encouraged to buy mids due to price. "Prices need to go lower" and besides there was plenty of corn available, he added.
One St Louis dealer said he expected moderate demand. People did not want to sell any cheaper because they were expecting premiums for December, he said.
But one Tennessee broker said there was some forward contracting for the catfish business.
In the northeast, a Buffalo broker pointed to an easing of supply due to to a slight drop in mill run times.
